notes.title: New Pretty Characters Update is finally available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/fb151f7eac7cb7f1c55bb08dce4a394b9fd46c18.jpg[/img]

Hey, Gas Jockeys!  

Big news straight from the desert: the New Pretty Characters Update is officially LIVE! 🎉
Yep, it's finally time to say goodbye to some of those, uh... “charmingly outdated” faces passing through your gas station and welcome a fresh new crowd with cleaner models, updated outfits, and more variety than 

These new NPC models don’t just look better – they’re also part of our ongoing quest to optimize the game. Thanks to tech improvements under the hood, we were able to make them both prettier and more efficient.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/2ccbf6568951dd3f200f6e8f22215e421538fa75.jpg[/img]

As we mentioned earlier, this update focuses solely on visuals – the behavior of your customers remains unchanged (yes, they will still honk if you leave them waiting too long). But we promise, they’ll look way better doing it now.

We're pleased to have prepared this update for you, but we’re even more excited about what’s to come. Our team is hard at work on future updates, and we’ll be sharing more information with you soon. Trust us – we're working on something you really wanted.

Until then, enjoy the new look, keep the shelves stocked, and maybe... sweep the floor once in a while?

Catch you at the pump – and don’t forget to overcharge the tourists! 😉

~ Sewek

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1149620/Gas_Station_Simulator/

notes.title: Please let us display our own custom movies devlog 🎥
notes.content:
[h1]Hey, Gas Jockeys! ⛽[/h1]

It’s me again with another exciting development sneak peek. This time we’ll be talking about one of the most anticipated features coming to the Drive-In Cinema DLC. In our last update, we talked about the minigames, events, and we finally have managed to reveal the release date of the DLC. If you still haven’t had the opportunity to read through the last announcement, you can freely do so right now by clicking this link. 

Today, we’re diving into something that we know many of you have been waiting for…Let’s see what that might be 👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/62ee4dec451f9d57e2e63126c6aa1e3c9c8424a7.jpg[/img]

[h2]Display Your Own Custom Movies🍿[/h2]

That’s right! We’ve read your countless comments regarding that feature and we obviously couldn’t have let you down. With this DLC, you’re no longer limited to pre-set films – you can now screen your own custom movies at your drive-in – the big screen is all yours to command 🤩However, there are some requirements that you need to obey. First of all, the only file format that is acceptable is .mp4. Second of all, the maximum duration of your custom movie cannot exceed 20 minutes. That’s still quite a long time to watch some of your old school clips on the big screen in the game, right? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/7ffc3054844f1149440681f1ad2d6d4372992a6e.jpg[/img]

[h2]Join us on Live Stream 🎮[/h2]

To celebrate the release of Gas Station Simulator - Drive-In Cinema DLC, we’ll be hosting a special live stream on [b]March 6th, 2025, at 6 PM CET[/b], where apart from playing the DLC, we’ll be answering your questions regarding the DLC, and anything else that might be bothering you. The stream will take place on our official twitch.tv channel. If you don’t want to miss it, make sure to follow us on twitch and mark the date in your calendars 📅

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/bcfc90369d38483a4611e3d8802816e975c20d4f.jpg[/img]

[h2]Stay up-to-date 📰[/h2]

And that’s it for today’s update! I’m really curious to see what kind of custom movies you will display when the Drive-In Cinema DLC launches next week. This DLC was purely made thanks to your feedback and ideas under the announcements and the discussion tab, so we cannot wait to give it into your hands. Having said that – Keep those comments coming as your support pushes us forward on this development journey and all of these updates and DLCs wouldn’t be possible without your constant feedback. Huge thanks for that from the entire DRAGO entertainment team ❤️ 

Last but not least, if you want to stay in the loop of everything Gas Station Sim, make sure to add the Drive-In Cinema DLC to your wishlist! Until the next devlog 👋

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3014630/Gas_Station_Simulator__DriveIn_Cinema_DLC/

[i]~Sewek[/i]

[i]By the way! Our friends at Garage Monkeys have crafted an exciting experience where every deal matters. Hone your skills, flip cars for profit, and build your dealership empire – all while navigating the unpredictable world of the automotive market! 

Car Dealer Simulator: Prologue is now available for free![/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3115010/Car_Dealer_Simulator_Prologue__Early_Days/

notes.title: All the ins and outs of Drive-In Cinema DLC 🎥
notes.content:
[h1]Hey, Gas Jockeys ⛽[/h1]

Welcome to another development update where I’m showing you what we’ve been cooking up for your beloved Gas Station Simulator. I’m so delighted to see that the recent Restocking Shelves Update has met your expectations (for most of you at least). On behalf of the entire DRAGO entertainment team, I’d like to really thank you from the bottom of our hearts for all of the amazing comments that we’ve received. ❤️

Now, on the main topic. I’m fully aware that it’s been a while since our announcement of Gas Station Simulator – Drive-In Cinema DLC. Moreover, we haven’t revealed much information about it so far, apart from releasing the Steam Page. But… Today we’re finally able to share some insights from the Drive-In Cinema DLC. We might even have a little tease regarding the release date, so stick with me till the end of this announcement. For now, let’s grab a favourite drink of yours, cover yourself with a warm blanket to create a cozy atmosphere, and let’s roll 🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/57084698022739233017741beb5e38f1aa9e750f.jpg[/img]

[h2]What is Drive-In Cinema DLC? 🤔[/h2]

The Drive-In Cinema DLC is a brand-new, free of charge addition to the Gas Station Simulator that brings extra revenue streams and possibility of further expansion. Your main goal? Acquiring additional space and setting up a drive-in theater complete with a modern projector and a giant screen. 

When all is set and one, it’s high time to introduce the cinema to your demanding clientele. Validate tickets, manage sneaky customers trying to get in for free, and invest in further upgrades like a popcorn machine to provide a complete movie-going experience. Grow your renown in order to attract more customers and expand your clientele. All of this coming soon for free! Oh… You may even use the popcorn to throw at Dennis, but more on that in the future announcements. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/f3275fd6de83b241bb93f54ae7bb681a886c373b.jpg[/img]

[h2]Will Drive-In Cinema have its own employees? 🧑‍🏭[/h2]

The answer is – yes, but actually no. At the beginning the goal of the DLC is to give you complete control over what’s happening in the drive-in cinema. However, as you grow your renown (yes, drive-in cinema will have its own renown) you’ll be able to purchase more upgrades that will automate most of the activities there (well… You still need to use a popcorn machine to fend off Dennis right?). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/47dd0b6b500a14ed9d807e15e2b91af867a90b53.jpg[/img]

[h2]Join us on a live stream next week 💥[/h2]

That’s right! We’ll be live streaming next Tuesday, 11th of February at 6 p.m CET. We’ll be talking about Drive-In Cinema DLC, answering your most common questions (about consoles and other games that are in development as well), and chilling while playing our beloved Gas Station Simulator. The stream will take place on our official twitch.tv channel, so don’t forget to follow us if you don’t want to miss the stream 👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/b53a8ddf534229d14f381522c4c1c34b3b5ac21e.jpg[/img]

[h2]Stay up-to-date 📰[/h2] 

So, that’s gonna be it for today’s announcement. Let me know your thoughts in the comment section below. As always, I’m more than happy to hear your feedback regarding projects that we’re working on. You can expect the next announcement coming next week in which I’ll be talking about how the projector, popcorn machine and the Drive-In Cinema renown works. Last but not least, if you want to stay in the loop of everything Gas Station Sim, consider adding Drive-In Cinema to your wishlist.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3014630/Gas_Station_Simulator__DriveIn_Cinema_DLC/?l=polish

[i]P.S. Ever wondered what it’s like to run your own car dealership? Car Dealer Simulator Prologue from our friends at Garage Monkeys lets you step into the world of buying, selling, and negotiating deals! [/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3115010/Car_Dealer_Simulator_Prologue__Early_Days/

notes.title: Restocking Shelves Update is Available Now 🔥
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/019089ca6cf631a8366d5e94444f6b97459c5410.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hey, Gas Jockeys! ⛽ [/h1]

I’m more than thrilled to announce that the Restocking Shelves Update is finally available for you to download. Make sure to update the game and while you wait, let’s dive right into what’s in store for you this time around 🤩

Yeap, you hear that right! From now on, your employees will finally have the possibility to restock those empty shelves and do the tedious work for you. Of course it’s totally up to you – you can still do it by yourself, but if you feel like you need some well-deserved rest, you can freely assign this task to one of your employees. If you want to see how it looks in the game, make sure to head over to our previous announcement 

Oh… And along with the update, our team has managed to fix some of the issues you’ve reported previously. Check the full patch notes below and let us know in the comments down below what you think 👇

[h2]Changes🔄[/h2]

[list]
[*] Automatic Restocking: now you can use your Employees to restock your Shelves. You can pick between automatic restocking and custom set up which allows you to control which products are restocked and when. We also reworked the mechanic of picking up shelves. 
[*] Challenges Rework: Challenges have been balanced in the Base Game and Tidal Wave. In TW, they contribute to reducing the volcano’s anger. For the ones already present in the Base Game, We’ve added two new challenges related to refueling boats. 
[*] In the Base Game, challenges have been modified based on the popularity level – up to level 8, challenges require fewer customers to be served and offer smaller rewards in terms of popularity points. After level 8, challenges require serving more customers but grant more popularity points.
[*] Show/Hide HUD: we added another Display Option that allows the player to hide HUD.
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes⚒️[/h2]
[h3]Base game⛽[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where 12 PM was displayed as 12 AM
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed player to place cigarettes shelves twice on the same slot after loading the game
[*] Fixed a FPS drop when Party Bus arrives at the Station
[*] Fixed a bug that required player to click on screen first in order to be able to skip cutscene
[*] Fixed a visual bug with wrong material on Fuel Delivery outflow that made it too dark
[*] Fixed a bug that caused blocking a fixed car on the Workshop lift after Save/Load
[*] Fixed a bug that showed picklocking challenge during the last cinematic
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a player to be stuck in sewers
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a player to coles Shelve UI with pressing any button
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Tobacco products to be hard to target on Shelves
[*] Fixed a landscape hole near the Workshop
[*] Fixed a visual bug that prevented some parts of the Workshop from loading properly on Notebook graphic setting
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented player from opening Tool menu pressing Tab
[*] Fixed a bug that stopped music when player entered Rudy
[*] Fixed a bug that caused incorrect display of Management Tab in 3440x1440 resolution
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Party Bus customers to be blocked by Police Car waiting for Fuel
[*] Fixed a bug that caused both levels of Christmas decorations to be displayed incorrectly
[*] Fixed missing localization for Hammer tool and new Cash Register
[*] Fixed a bug that caused display of wrong Cash Register model after Save/Load
[*] Fixed a bug with incorrect font for Party Time Timer in Polish version of the game
[*] Fixed a bug that caused employees to get stuck in car wash ruins
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a game to crash when player went back to washing car after popularity cutscene
[*] Fixed a various problems with spawning Employees 
[/list]


[h3]Tidal Wave🏝️[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed player to set up multiple queues to the Cash Register
[*] Fixed a bug that caused music to stop when using PC management tab
[*] Fixed a visual bug with missing lighting at the entrance of the Level 8 Gas Station
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a Workshop lights to get turned off i player exited the Workshop holding Shift
[*] Replaced a wrong picture for Lvl 1 Car Wash in Upgrade Tree
[*] Removed redundant stone that appeared only on High Graphic setting
[/list] 


[h3]Airstrip✈️[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug with Joe’s crash site spawning above the map.
[*] Fixed a visual bug with incorrect placement of the hats on the hanger
[*] Fixed a visual bug with disappearing smoke from Joe’s plane
[*] Fixed a bug that significantly reduced chances for success after a failed trade
[*] Fixed a bug that started Sandstorms before the first trade
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Joe to have incorrect position on bench after Save/Load
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused Joe’s plane to smoke even after towing it to hangar
[*] 
[/list]

[h3]Junkyard⚙️[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that changed quest to Junkyard questline after loading the game
[*] Fixed a bug that showed Car Wreck UI during the cutscenes
[*] Fixed incorrect description in Square Lvl 4 Upgrade
[*] Fixed a bug that caused to show incorrect “Money Lost” value after a failed delivery
[*] Removed redundant Projectors tutorial
[/list]

[h2]Stay up-to-date 📰[/h2]

We hope this update enhances your Gas Station Simulator experience and helps you keep those shelves looking spick and span. As always, thank you for your continued support, and be sure to let us know your thoughts. Until the next devlog! 

[i]~Sewek[/i]

[i]P.S Our friends over Garage Monkeys wanted us to share that Car Dealer Simulator: Prologue just had its release. The free introduction to the base game allows you to get your hands-on the core mechanics of the game, so if you’re looking for something to pass the time over the weekend, feel free to check it out. [/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3115010/Car_Dealer_Simulator_Prologue__Early_Days/

notes.title: Restocking Shelves Update when?🤔
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/0b6fc3c59bf4106f7b62db06e3a19076cc107aa1.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hey, Gas Jockeys! ⛽[/h1]

Welcome to the first announcement of 2025! I hope you had an amazing time during the Christmas break and you’ve celebrated New Year with a blast 💥But worry no more if you’ve had a rather peaceful time – I’m gonna do my best to get you in the proper mood, cause the news I bring today are definitely from the jaw-dropping category, as we finally know when the long-awaited feature is gonna be available in our beloved Gas Station Simulator 👀Let the games begin then! 🔥

Now, I won't leave you without anything spicy, so what about a little sneak peek into the restocking shelves and how it looks right now, shall we?

Unfortunately, all good things must come to an end. Let me know in the comments down below how many of you cannot wait for the restocking shelves update. notes.title: Gas Station Simulator – Employee Update is available now!🔥
notes.content:
Hey, Gas Jockeys! ⛽

Not gonna lie – the excitement is getting off the charts as we’re thrilled to announce that [b]the Employee Update is finally here![/b] I understand that you might be busy playing the new update right now, so I won’t take much time from you today. However, I’d highly advise you to stick with me ‘till the end as I have the privilege to reveal what is coming to the Gas Station Simulator universe. So let’s see what I’ve got for you this time. 

[h2]Employee Update 🧑‍💼[/h2]

With the much anticipated Employee Update, you’ll now have the possibility to hire [b]two additional employees, schedule everyone’s work[/b] thanks to day/night shifts, [b]prioritize their tasks[/b], and pay them their rightful wages – all of this within one tab accessible via the computer. How convenient is that? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/068a89f60015c47b0cfe7cc4842bb16093938133.jpg[/img]

[h2]Employee Update patch notes📒[/h2]

In addition to all the employee-related stuff, I’ve also managed to sneak around our office and steal the patch notes from the dev team. Just don’t tell them that I just did that, okay? 

[h3]Gas Station Simulator⛽[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with a certain car causing traffic jam near spawning points
[*]Fixed an issue that caused drivers to choose the wrong path while driving a car out of a parking lot
[*]Fixed an issue that caused small car “Maluch” to pick up wrong path when driving away from fuel pump
[*]Car spawn points are no longer visible
[*]Collected cards no longer respawn after hiding and showing Landmarks
[*]The triangular part of the roof is now properly paintable at Gas Station level 2
[*]Fixed an issue with cleaning employee being stuck if we pick up last trash right before them
[*]Employee that cleaned everything will now correctly resume his work when new trash/dirt stains appears
[*]Fixed an issue that created an empty save file
[*]Tutorial for car fueling no longer pops up twice
[*]Multiple corrections to environment and assets
[*]Party Bus Customers no longer have stretched tongues
[*]Talking to the employee no longer prevents him from continuing his work
[*]Customers will now pick the correct way into the station if some decorations are placed near the entrance
[/list]

[h3]Party Time🥳[/h3]
[list]
[*]Ice Cream delivery truck no longer leaves before being unpacked
[/list]

[h3]Gas Station Simulator – Airstrip DLC✈️[/h3]
[list]
[*]Broom tutorial no longer blocks the view in Marshall Wands minigame
[*]Fixed an issue that caused blockade of inputs while clicking on Marshall Wands
[*]Multiple corrections to environment and assets
[/list]

[h2]Gas Station Simulator – Tidal Wave DLC is coming🌊 [/h2]

Yes, you read that right – the whole DRAGO entertainment team is thrilled to announce the new addition to the Gas Station Simulator universe. Gas Jockeys, welcome the Tidal Wave DLC. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/a2ea454097ea21f84338d41d033a1f80b7dd726f.png[/img]

[h2]Key features 🔑[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Pay attention to the God’s mood[/b] – Experience the wrath and benevolence of Chunchumanchu with the revolutionary Volcano Meter. This unique gauge serves as a direct reflection of the god's mood. As time passes or customer dissatisfaction mounts, Chunchumanchu's anger will grow, bringing unforeseen challenges to your island oasis.

[*][b]Keep up the harmony[/b] – Balance the island's precarious harmony by performing sacred offerings at the altar. Toss coconuts, shells, or other items into the caldera to appease Chunchumanchu. Each action carries a distinct impact on lowering the god's anger and preserving your business.

[*][b]Expand in the way you want to[/b] – In Tidal Wave, players will have the unique opportunity to freely expand their Gas Station empire. No objective limitations – just you and your money. 

[*][b]Face the consequences of your actions[/b] – Fail to maintain the god's favor, and prepare for a cataclysmic eruption that transforms your paradise into a fiery hellscape. Business will grind to a halt and customers will flee in terror. Can you keep Chunchumanchu at bay?

[*][b]Mortal Business Logic[/b] – Equip your Gas Station and other structures wisely. Neglecting proper maintenance can lead to accidents, resulting in the escalation of Chunchumanchu's anger. Monitor equipment durability carefully to minimize risks.

[*][b]Engage with a variety of different activities[/b] – Diversify your repertoire by providing scuba diving and surfing rentals. But beware, equipment neglect can lead to accidents that will directly affect the Volcano meter's volatile mood swings.

[*][b]Confront threats that lurk in the ocean[/b] – A lurking shark adds an element of danger as it occasionally targets your customers. Quickly react by throwing objects or deploying underwater mines to protect your patrons and profits.

[*][b]And much, much more[/b] – Fuel jet skis, receive cargo by boat, and confront unexpected weather phenomena such as gray sandstorms and thunders, making each day on the island a new challenge.
[/list]

We’ve also just revealed the Steam page for our upcoming DLC, so if you don’t want to miss any future updates, consider adding it to your wishlist 🙇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2600880/Gas_Station_Simulator__Tidal_Wave_DLC/

[h2]Stay up-to-date[/h2]

Unfortunately, this is the end of our announcement. Thank you so much for sticking with me till the end, folks! Last but not the least – we’re open to hear your comments and feedback regarding not only the employee update, but also our freshly announced DLC. The stage is yours, gas jockeys – any comment that you share is valuable, so don’t hesitate to leave those down below. See you in the future devlogs! 

~Your humble marketing guy – Sewek

notes.title: Manage your way up to the top - Scheduling System Devlog
notes.content:
[i]Hey there![/i]

We’re here to make your life in Dust Bowl much easier - managing a whole gas empire would be difficult without help of your employees, wouldn’t it? Well, the news is that [b]with the upcoming Employee Update things are about to get much smoother [/b]- today we’re talking about a whole new Scheduling System. 

[b]Grab yourself some coffee or tea, and let’s roll![/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/b15ebc4eb55bd024ec4360a5238c12af96c1983a.png[/img]

[b]UI-wise we decided to make it clear and simple - no excel spreadsheets, no meetings that could’ve been an e-mail, no corporate atmosphere. Just you, your employees, and your task manager. [/b]

Starting with the left side, you can access all the info about your employee - it’s important to get to know them better, right? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/5f4265f321a4cdedaa84cc0ee398d4185c60bbe4.gif[/img]

[b]Other than their backstory, you can also access your employee’s skill levels here - how convenient! [/b]

Next up we have those two buttons:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/c5ff5349b07f5b44ba8d61feb738a1560743ac67.png[/img]

[b]The orange one sends your employee back to their camper[/b] - let’s say Riccardo get’s stuck. What do I do? I just press the button resetting his position, so he can get back to work. 
[b]The red button can be used to fire your employee whenever you’re not happy with them[/b] - damn, let’s hope you won’t have to use it. 

And here’s our favorite part of the whole system - task management:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/5b9a763dd49d1b036b388d84e268679733c838b5.png[/img]

[b]You can task your employee with two different actions at a time - the upper one will have a higher priority, which means the lower one will be executed once the employee is done with the other activity. 
[/b]
In this example Riccardo will be fueling cars whenever there’s a client waiting to get it done - if nobody’s waiting, he’ll be repairing cars instead. 

[b]IMPORTANT:[/b] You can see a little checkbox next to the tasks - it allows you to activate and deactivate actions. If both of the actions are inactive, the employee will return to their camper. Deactivating the action with the higher priority automatically deactivates the other activity as well. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/186311bb277bc4ba0b3df3dff5b1ceb9648e8eaa.png[/img]

Now, for the finance-management part, we have employee’s salary. [b]Whenever they are doing their job, they accumulate a certain amount of money they will have to be paid whenever they go on a break in order for them to come back to work. [/b]
The yellow button with a star means you can give your employee a bonus that will [b]replenish their stamina bar and allow them to work overhours. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/32de8fb7e82bae6de58c265590123e023e9cb2fa.png[/img]

And last, but not least - [b]we have two different shifts now! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/ad9c0c72c647445778a67e75c8d9d9bec76b2b9e.png[/img]

[b]Here you can choose whether the employee is gonna work night shifts or day shifts on your station[/b] (or both if you give them a bonus salary). 

On the right side you also can see how much you have to pay your employee at the end of their shift - if the checkbox is ticked, the game will automatically pay the salary with your funds. 


And that’s it for today! [b]Stay tuned for the rest of the devlogs regarding The Employee Update![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/e1e6898848e7558c78caa42085c024bfc031ac61.png[/img]

By the way, you should definitely check out our Airstrip DLC, and also Car For Sale Simulator if you want to have some more time while waiting for the Employee Update!

notes.title: Airstrip DLC development update #2 – Meet Joe👨‍✈️
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40265429/9a46b5a4b794698f43adcdb588d90d8213e84464.jpg[/img]
Hey, Gas Jockeys! ⛽

We're back with another devlog that will familiarize you with the Gas Station Simulator – Airstrip DLC. Recently, we've shared some brief information about the game, but as we've read through the comments, we've realized that some of you don't know what the DLC is going to be about. Thus, in this development update, we'll share some more information about the main character in the game, his background story, and his role in the game. 

Before we move further, we'd like to invite you to our next devlog that will be live on Saturday (we're going to show some new mechanics, so you don't want to miss that one 🔥). Without further ado, let's jump into the main topic of today's devlog! 🤩

[h2]Joe's background story 📝[/h2]

As we announced in the last devlog, Airstrip DLC will have its own, unique campaign that you'll be able to complete. Along with that, we felt that there is a need to add a brand-new character that is strictly related to the DLC but also is familiar with the area where Gas Station Simulator takes place. As a result, we've created Joe – a US Air Force pilot, and war veteran, who suffers from PTSD due to his traumatic experiences in the past. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40265429/72ca35d7d50052ef13e7bf505fb4b71661083432.jpg[/img]

At first, he might be unpleasant, but as you progress through the game, you'll realize that he is a warm, honest, and most importantly trustworthy man, who you can rely on. However, the question is – how did Joe end up here? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40265429/4553c5cb77574ce8305fbe50943ec8e327599ff6.png[/img]

Fortunately for him, one of his old friends has offered him a share in a business he has been running for a while. Both of them decided to take the path of smugglers – they were responsible for transferring goods to the US from Central and South America. Somehow, Joe became fascinated by Latin American culture and decided to focus his efforts on finding the legendary Aztec and Montezuma gold.   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40265429/e58bb77059aab1c4c6a9cfe6d0feab8d304493b9.png[/img]

[h2]Joe's role in the game✈️[/h2]

As we said at the beginning, Joe is the main character of the DLC. Apart from that, he will also introduce you to a new area of the game. In addition, you'll be able to interact with Joe, and by doing so, you'll get the chance to upgrade the Airstrip area and unlock new tools that will be useful throughout the rest of the game. 

[h2]The new set of animations 💥[/h2]

As we're getting closer and closer to the release date, we'd like to present to you a new set of animations that we've been recently working on. These are still work-in-progress stuff, but you can already get a glimpse of how Joe looks in the game. Oh, and feel free to share your thoughts regarding the animations and Joe himself. 

[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40265429/8ff27671d65b535a15d547c786fb46aa54230ecb.gif[/img]
[/list]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40265429/dc4f1bddf111d631ae33c88f5e6687982937cd64.gif[/img]
[/list]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40265429/6b2d0e3b4edc19f34e65c47f921650406f9b3e5e.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h2]Towy's Sneak Peek👀[/h2]

Surprise, surprise! From today, you might notice a new truck that has been added (but you can't control it just yet) to the base game. This is Towy – a new vehicle that will be helpful in the Airstrip DLC. We'll dive into details on Saturday, so stay tuned for that. We're curious if you can guess in which cases you'll need to use our new friend, so feel free to leave your answers in the comments. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40265429/550de9ea3ea714fa591966e2f31eb65dc2c7c430.jpg[/img]

[h2]Party Bus Optimization 🚌[/h2]

As we've read your comments, we also realized that many of you've had some performance issues during the Party Bus event. Fortunately, we can finally say that this has been fixed, and you shouldn't have any problems with that from now on. Additionally, we're still working on fixes and making the game better in general, so your feedback is much appreciated. 🙏

[h2]Stay up-to-date 📰[/h2]

And we've come to an end, fellow Jockeys! ⛽ We hope that you've enjoyed the stuff that we showed today. We cannot wait to see your feedback, so feel free to drop it in the comments below. If you don't want to miss any future updates regarding the Airstrip DLC, consider adding it to your wishlist if you haven't done it yet 🙇

notes.title: Early Days is getting an update soon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40265429/ccb20bcda06a8ea93a6023d7fe13dcc1526ecf0d.jpg[/img]

It has been a while, no question about that, where we promised to fix a couple of things in Early Days, especially the achievements. 

We haven’t done it not because we were lazy though. We actually fixed the achievements and some other things around September last year. And then the trouble started. After failing 4 internal tests during the next 2 months or so and revisiting the problem over and over again, because the fixes we borrowed from the full version of the game, caused issues elsewhere, we had to admit to ourselves that this doesn’t lead anywhere.

There is only a certain amount of time and resources we can allow ourselves to spend on a free product and no matter how we looked it, the time and effort needed was just outside that scope.
On the other hand, we really wanted to fix these things as the prologue to Gas Station Simulator is still quite popular. 

Long story short, starting with the new year we decided we need a different approach and do it properly. While the achievement and various bug fixes would be nice, we weren’t entirely happy due to missing out all the optimizations and improvements we did for the full game over the past year anyway. 

So we decided to approach it differently and revamp the entire Early Days prologue to match the codebase of the full game. All the things we fixed, improved and optimized in the full game will go into Early Days now. The prologue will remain the same in scope, but now it will match the full game in terms of improvements.

As it turns out, we did a lot in Gas Station Simulator since we released Early Days and we added small things at the start here and there. So the revamped prologue will be a lot better. There is however one downside to this approach: as it looks right now, we are unlikely to be able to convert your old save games to be used in the revamped prologue. There are just so many new tweaks, that as of now we don’t have an idea how to make it happen. On the other hand, that is the only downside, everything is else is going to be so much better!

We do not have an exact release date for the revamped prologue just yet, but it’s already in internal testing and doing very well so far. To give you at least a raw estimate, think along the lines of a couple of weeks. Yes, we know, more waiting, but at least we are close. And hey, maybe you’d like to fill that time with a look at the prologue to our Winter Survival that gets release later today:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2175210/Winter_Survival_Prologue/

Hey, Gas Jockeys! ⛽

Last week, we shared with you a little sneak peek from the upcoming Valentine's Update. Fortunately, the update is already live just before the weekend, so you can create the station of your dreams. 

We've also managed to fix some of the issues that players have encountered. Last but not least, we heard your voices and with the Valentine's Update it is now possible to [b]exit the painting mini-game[/b]. Check the full patch notes below for more details:⬇️


[h3]Valentine’s Content❤️[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adds a Valentine’s themed Landmark.
[*] Adds 3 Valentine’s themed wallpapers.
[*] Adds 10 Valentine’s themed decals.
[*] For the Can Touch This DLC this update also adds Valentine’s themed wall, doors, 2 types of windows and roof.
[/list]
[h3]Improvements⚒️[/h3]
[list]
[*] It’s now possible to exit the painting mini-game.
[*] Rotating standing decorations/shelves should now be smoother and we reduced the speed while at it. You can now hold the SHIFT-key while rotating to speed it up.
[*] You can now hold the Left Mouse Button on the plus button while ordering to quickly add multiple products/car parts/ice creams.
[*] You can now save up to three order lists per shop type. They will be available after loading a game. In addition, there is an option to use the previous order that is remembered until loading a game.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes🐛[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ice Cream mini-game: customers will no longer unnecessary react to the bell after being served.
[*] Ice Cream mini-game: fixes a bug that made replacing empty containers impossible.
[*] Fixes the issue that caused trash to fall under the floor.
[*] Fixes an issue that allowed hanging decorations and shelves on occupied spots after loading a saved game.
[*] Fixes a bug that caused decorations and shelves to disappear while aiming at some walls.
[*] The Ferris Wheel should now work correctly.
[*] Information about items stolen by the Biker (after not paying a loan) will now be correctly displayed.
[*] The Party Bus (Party Time DLC) should no longer get stuck on a fence.
[*] Wheels in the Workshop should no longer fall out of your hands.
[*] AZERTY keyboard now works correctly with keybindings.
[/list]

And that's it, fellow jockeys! Don't forget to share your Valentine's-styled stations with us on our discord or via Steam forums. notes.title: Managing Crucial Aspects
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/450031e3a02457e7a002462ffe3069a41c284ed9.jpg[/img]

Whether your business is handling or running four wheels or running on four wheels, there are a few basic rules to follow. When you master these common factors, you will become really a business shark in an ocean of opportunities. Let's analyze two economic activities that may become yours even today: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1160920/Food_Truck_Simulator/]Food Truck[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1149620/Gas_Station_Simulator/]Gas Station[/url]. 

[h3]Renown[/h3]
Fame has different appearances and in Gas Station Simulator we like to call it "popularity". If an adventure on Route 66 is still ahead of you, popularity is a system that tracks feedback from your customers. Do not exceed the required amount of fuel while fulfilling the order. Check out each product carefully and do not scatter them on the floor. Take care of the gas station so that it is clean and its shelves are not empty. These and many other activities contribute to increased popularity, which means higher traffic, the possibility of further expanding and developing the gas station and unique visual rewards. For those who are struggling to reach the maximum popularity level, we hear you! We are working on a new way to increase popularity to make leveling more enjoyable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/f21b9cefc2d1d79f4434bacc75a79d4280962c00.jpg[/img]

For [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1160920/Food_Truck_Simulator/]Food Truck Simulator[/url], based on the experience and feedback in Gas Station Simulator, we have created a new system called  “prestige” that approaches this topic slightly differently. There is nothing more sensitive than a customer with an empty belly, and as a chef and salesman you will meet many of them. Be careful because such a customer might be a ticking bomb that will damage your prestige when exploding. How to avoid it? Feed them properly. Keep an eye on the ingredients and don't make them wait too long. Take care of cleanliness! Nobody wants to eat a grilled burger that's wrapped in burnt fat. If you manage to do it, it will open up a whole host of new opportunities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/1413f6765a67eb9326be89cdda6f483e01cfe561.jpg[/img]

[h3]Time[/h3]
If you thought you would have peace of mind at a gas station in the middle of nowhere, then you are almost right. The business beginnings are usually slow, and later on you can either take a break by closing the gas station or get help by hiring employees. Nevertheless, once you spread your wings and start offering fuel, a cool drink or a bathroom as the only place within dozens of miles, don't be surprised when a wave of customers floods you. May you be prepared for this in advance and have a warehouse full of products and tanks full of fuel. Time is not your ally, so keep an eye on it.
In Food Truck Simulator, time management begins in the garage. Plan a route, analyze all strategic places, and when you are ready, start the engine and show off with your driving skills. If you manage to get to the supply store on time before the competition, you will get a better offer. Be late and pay full price like any other. The next stop? The selling point where the time and mass of hungry customers stand against your kitchen under your command.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/6cbdd52502c4de4ffafa88c2d538216e8390b97b.jpg[/img]
	
[h3]Progress[/h3]
	This point applies to both your business and you personally. Let's start with the Food Truck. Traveling through the corners of the city, makes you discover new locations that will provide a greater business range. You meet new people, thanks to whom you will expand your service scope. Over time, your vehicle will become a better mobile kitchen, and you will become a better driver which will allow you to get to further places faster. However, you can also focus on any single selling point. Focus on your favorite type of kitchen, which will please both you and the consumer. Some say that a good cook is not one who has trained 10,000 dishes, but one who practiced a dish  10,000 times. 
	And how to manage this in a desert? Las Vegas and Dubai were also built on empty sand. So remember the day you wake up for the first time as the owner of this not very spectacular abandoned gas station. Think of it a month later as you enter a huge and refurbished facility. Recall the initial silence when you hear the clamor of constant engines and people around you. When you go inside the workshop to save a customer's vacation or use the car wash to make sure someone's date goes well, think of the piles of sand that stood where these structures are now. The future is in your hands.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/823299ccf1a1bce6258c454be19772c285b70db1.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35762680/4b3917b75a739cc1f55879351e151dd700d45d1b.jpg[/img]

[h3]Express yourself[/h3]
	This is your business. You are your own boss and don't be afraid to show it in an artistic way. Whether it's a gas station or a food truck, you'll start your working day with a smile when you look at your handiwork with pride. There are plenty of customisation options in both games and we intend to add even more! 

Gas Station Simulator is obviously available already and Food Truck Simulator will be released in few weeks on [b]September, 14th[/b]:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1160920/Food_Truck_Simulator/

notes.title: Patch #1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40265429/3e2b3327cbdc2324d0a0d7be8dc940b4b38e90ae.jpg[/img]

We just updated the game with some of the most requested changes as well as the much needed fix for key bindings.

[b]Key Bindings[/b]
[list]
[*] We fixed an issue with Keybindings getting unbound which prevented lockpicking minigame to be finished as well as keybinds unbinding themselves. Hopefully it should no longer be possible to get stuck and having to manually delete the configuration files. 
Should you still encounter keybinding related issues, please let us know.
[*] There are still issues with rebinding keys and resetting keybindings that we will continue working on and are currently top priority for us. Gameplay UI also does not reflect changes of rebound keys, that is something that we will address at a later date.
[/list]
[b]Lock-picking[/b]
[list]
[*] Lock-picking mini-game can now be operated with a mouse instead of the Q and E keys, but is a slightly harder when doing so.
[*] We increased the chance of finding decorations when breaking into cars.
[*] We increased the amount of money you gain from breaking into cars.
[/list]
[b]NPCs[/b]
[list]
[*] NPC's should drop slightly less trash now.
[/list]
[b]Dennis[/b]
[list]
[*] We reduced the frequency of Dennis spawning in regular gameplay significantly.
[*] We also added an Event Settings to 'Gameplay' - 'Dennis Vandalizes Walls', allowing you to turn off Dennis coming to your gas station. By default this setting is disabled.
[/list]
[b]Paint[/b]
[list]
[*] Paint on walls now decays significantly slower.
[*] The time it takes to paint a wall has been reduced.
[*] We addressed an issue where painting walls was more difficult on faster machines. Wall Painting should now respect your computer speed and be more consistent across the board rather than extremely difficult on good computers and easy on slower ones.
[/list]
[b]Quality of Life & Miscellaneous[/b]
[list]
[*] The mouse pointer should now center on the middle when opening the Tab Menu.
[*] Leaderboards can now be filtered by Global, Friends as well as showing few above/below your own result.
[*] The excavator's back-pipes should no longer fly around in Cutscenes.
[/list]
[b]Optimizations[/b]
[list]
[*] We optimised the distanced based visual effects which should yield a performance improvement across most specs.
[/list]
Please keep in mind that you have to quit the game in order for Steam to apply the update.

notes.title: Hotfix for the wrong language issue.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40265429/bbae8023af8acd8d1e2b9ccb0332d4cc22948278.jpg[/img]

We have just deployed a small patch to fix the problem where the game did not launch in English as intended. Steam should update your game automatically as soon as the game isn’t currently running.

What happened is: we are currently working on adding languages to the prologue and there was a mismatch in the recent build that snuck in after testing. Obviously the programmer responsible will be punished accordingly, most likely by having to learn some exotic language…

Just in case you run into some issues or bugs, please let us know here on Steam or the [url=https://discord.gg/e3bAWt7] DRAGO Community Discord [/url]. We will try to resolve them in a timely manner.
